caveats: ARIMA mean value is assessed through noisy squared-return volatility proxies and QLIKE loss.

hypothesis: H2: Heavy-tailed/asymmetric GARCH variants improve forecasts.
key_evidence: Best advanced GARCH validation/test QLIKE 1.611304/1.032548; DM p=0.0181113653808202; Holm p=1.0.
caveats: The selected best GARCH-family model may be symmetric or asymmetric; see selected-model table for specification.

key_evidence: Best validation-selected refit model Refit-BestAsymmetric-rolling_1000_monthly; validation/test QLIKE 1.599196/1.067672; DM p=0.8489724206007725.
caveats: Protocol selection uses validation QLIKE; test table also reports non-selected protocol outcomes for audit only.

hypothesis: H4: Hybrid/neural forecasts add incremental information.
key_evidence: Best combo ComboStack-PoolD_AllStable validation/test QLIKE 1.496227/1.113530; best validation econometric Refit-BestAsymmetric-rolling_1000_monthly test QLIKE 1.067672; combo DM p=0.5073708506038361.
caveats: Combination gains can be small and are tested again in encompassing and incremental-information tables.

hypothesis: H5: Log-target neural models mainly suffer from scale bias.
key_evidence: Average raw log-target test QLIKE 2.225569, best calibrated 1.146217; pred/actual ratio 0.273 -> 1.496.
caveats: If calibrated QLIKE remains materially worse than GARCH, the issue is not just scale bias.

hypothesis: H6: Best QLIKE models improve risk management.
key_evidence: Closest 5% VaR coverage: ARIMA-GARCH violation rate 0.047; best test QLIKE model: ComboPair-BestGARCHFamily_HybridQLIKE.
caveats: VaR uses Normal quantiles for all models, so distribution-specific tail parameters are not credited here.
